term: objective truth: legacy parameter, actual-stable, invariance-only or actual-only calibration
resolution: The legacy source claims quantify an independently supplied ObjectiveTruth predicate and retain their original types and attitude-independence gloss. They do not identify it with any new calibration. The new analyst actual-stable account includes truth; invariance-only does not, and actual-only omits stability. These are extensional operational accounts in one supplied profile, not property identity, robust/minimal truth, a census of historical schools, or a proof of genuine causal independence from attitudes. Their extensions can overlap, so exclusivity is not assumed. Only the weaker truth-component bridge is used to extend POE-EXTERNAL-PREMISE-VS-EMOTIVISM. No natural-evil or internal-critique refutation follows. Named coverage is an open proposition; the structural fork retains a genuine remaining-extension branch.
